## Task and scope

Task ID from TASKS.md:

Primary owner: A / B

Describe the change and any shared contract/policy impact.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated; full suite and type checking pass.
- [ ] The other track reviewed shared schema/CLI/configuration changes.
- [ ] Gate failure, unavailable evidence and service errors remain distinct.
- [ ] No future evidence, duplicate sources or retries inflate a score.
- [ ] README/task status updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No incident exports, real roster, credentials, private endpoints or generated private reports are committed.

Use synthetic examples in the PR. Share approved private evidence outside GitHub as required by policy.
